reviews.text: Mr. Guerrero. Very good program, but the steps of Adidas, which is not in the market, was better than this one.

Made me Money…. I love this app.
Many apps, track many things. But I was referred this one by my orthopedic foot surgeon. Fast forward to this review and I have been using DoSteps for a long time. And having this kind of statistics helped me in having a voice when it came time for a raise. I was telling them I walked between 13-18 miles a day, and they felt differently because of the previous employee who did that same job for 23 years and never walked that much…..
Ty DoSteps.
Phil Jr
STL MO

reviews.text:
OK app, would give better stars but zero support options.. I do use the app on the watch, but I have questions and suggestions. The support option here just goes to a website in German, with no means to send an email or anything. So that means there is no support. Just correct me where I’m wrong. 

Ich nutze die App auf der Uhr, habe aber Fragen und Anregungen. Die Support-Option hier führt nur zu einer Website in deutscher Sprache, ohne eine E-Mail oder ähnliches zu senden. Das heißt, es gibt keine Unterstützung. Korrigiert mich einfach, wo ich falsch liege.
Wildly inaccurate. Overcounts steps by at least double! No obvious way to calibrate it. Deleted and subscription cancelled after 20 minutes.
Pointless. Not accurate. According to this I only use the stairs a couple of times a day. I know for fact that I go up and down stairs at least 10 times a day.

Steps for the day. Started with a target of 10,000 realised how hard that would be so reduced to 5,000
